invariants: INV-GOV-WORKER-STATELESS-RECOVERY: Worker state must be fully reconstructible from remote Git repository and sealed capsules.
INV-GOV-WORKER-RECOVERY-READ-ONLY: Upon timeout, crash, or ambiguous tool failure, execution must immediately enter RECOVERY_READ_ONLY.

provisions.statement: Task capsules must embed recovery context including verified task HEAD, clean worktree status, and next safe step.
A recovering agent must verify remote HEAD before planning or mutating subsequent files.

scope: Deterministic worker state reconstruction from Git and capsule graph without relying on local session state.
title: Synthesis Stateless Worker Recovery and Isolation Contract
